name: knobas test estate
description: The real test infrastructure knobas is developed against: this notebook, OrbStack's Linux VM and the Docker engine in it, and the containers testenv/docker-compose.yml runs there -- Gitea and Uptime Kuma, and the real TeamCity, Jira and Confluence that `testenv/live` starts on demand, one at a time (#633). Data about an estate that exists -- nothing here is invented, and nothing Tidewater-shaped belongs in it. The `monitors` names are the names the local Uptime Kuma actually holds, seeded from `monitors.json` (#441). Until 2026-10-12 three Hetzner servers held the JVM products; they were decommissioned (#634) and left this file with them.

assets.name: knobas test estate
assets.description: The root. Environment and owner are set here only; everything below inherits them from the nearest ancestor that sets them (spec §12.1).

assets.name: devs-MacBook-Pro
assets.description: The development notebook, and the machine `just check` and every live recipe run on. Typed hypervisor because what it holds here is the Linux VM OrbStack runs; the type table has no name for a physical workstation. Its `ip` is the address the containers in that VM reach it at -- what `host.docker.internal` resolves to under OrbStack -- and the address the `notebook` ping watches.

assets.name: OrbStack Linux VM
assets.description: OrbStack's Linux VM, where the notebook's Docker engine runs. Its 8 GB is what holds one JVM product at a time (#633); `docker info` read 12 CPUs and 8392974336 bytes on 2026-10-12.

assets.name: Docker engine (OrbStack)
assets.description: The engine `testenv/docker-compose.yml` brings every service up on: Gitea and Uptime Kuma, and, on demand through `testenv/live`, the real TeamCity, Jira and Confluence with what each needs.

assets.name: knobas-gitea
assets.description: Gitea: a real product, the Gitea adapter's witness, and the VCS the TeamCity builds clone from over the compose network. On demand since #633: `just live-up gitea`, and `just live-up teamcity` brings it up first.

assets.name: knobas-uptime-kuma
assets.description: Uptime Kuma v2: the system of record for every monitor this file names. It does not watch itself.

assets.name: knobas-mockd
assets.description: Our own mock of Jira Data Center and TeamCity. Deprecated since 2026-09-03 (ADR-0013) and unmonitored: it is recorded because the compose file still runs it, and it leaves this file the day the service goes.

assets.name: knobas-teamcity
assets.description: The TeamCity server. On demand: `just live-up teamcity` starts it beside Gitea, and `just live-down teamcity` stops it and keeps its volumes, so the next start finds it seeded.

assets.name: teamcity
assets.description: TeamCity's internal database. There is no database container for it: the engine is embedded in the server, which is what the compose file's comment rules and what `down -v` throws away.

assets.name: knobas-teamcity-agent
assets.description: The one build agent, because a server with none runs nothing. It publishes no port and has no monitor of its own; it starts and stops with its server.

assets.name: knobas-jira
assets.description: Jira Software Data Center 10.3 LTS, on a 10-user, 3-hour timebomb licence. On demand: `just live-down jira` removes it with its volumes, because a kept volume is a product whose licence has already run out.

assets.name: knobas-jira-db
assets.description: Jira's PostgreSQL, started and removed with Jira.

assets.name: knobas-confluence
assets.description: Confluence Data Center, the only contract there is for it: Atlassian publishes no machine-readable Confluence DC spec. On demand, and removed with its volumes, as Jira is.

assets.name: knobas-confluence-db
assets.description: Confluence's PostgreSQL, started and removed with Confluence.

routes.name: mockd Jira Data Center REST v2
gitea (compose network)
routes.description: Gitea by its compose service name, on the network every container in this engine shares. TeamCity's VCS roots name it so, and a build clones through it; the `gitea` monitor watches the same host.
